notes: Update notices moved to where you can act on them: an Update available button in the toolbar menu, and a banner at the top of Settings (dismiss it with × and it stays hidden for that version).
This What's New window opens after each update, with the latest changes on top.
Removed the pop-up update notice from the writing panels.
Fixed stray <text_to_edit> tags showing up in replies from small local models, such as Apple's on-device model.
AI setup is now one list: My Models. Add a model by picking a provider, validating your key, choosing from the provider's live model list (with suggestions marked ★), and testing it.
Add several models and drag them into order: the top one is your default, and PenPal automatically falls back to the next if one doesn't respond, telling you which model answered.
Local servers (Apple Foundation Models, Ollama, LM Studio and more) use the same Add model flow.
Your existing setup was converted automatically.
Works with local servers that block browser requests, such as Apple Foundation Models Serve on macOS.
PenPal always asks local servers for a complete (non-streamed) reply.
The History window shows how many rewrites are saved out of your limit, e.g. "100 of 250 saved rewrites".
Changing the output language re-does your latest reply in the new language in every view.
Edit and Shorten buttons on every reply, in every view.
Edit and Shorten buttons on every PenPal reply. Shorten makes a tighter version in the same tone; Edit loads a reply back into the input box.
Copy now sits in the same button row below each reply.
New Rewrite History: open it from the clock button in any view or from the toolbar menu, then Copy or Edit any past rewrite.
Choose how many rewrites to keep (default 100) under Settings → AI Models & Settings → History.
The full-screen tab clears the input after you submit, and your messages there have an Edit button.
